body:
Long story short I bought some vicodin 5/500s which contain 500 milligrams of acetaminophen and 5 milligrams of hydrocodone from a bud and wanted to take them without having to take all the tylenol. I've done this many times before. I made a 40 milligram cold water extraction using this method:
I took the 8 pills (I usually use 10 pills because they are only 5mgs) and crushed them up thoroughly using a mortar and pestle, grinding the shit out of them until it is a fine powder because chunks take longer to dissolve which means more stirring...
Got a cup, less than a full coffee cup is more than enough for a 50mg extraction generally I just want enough to make a liquid. I make sure it is not like a sludge more is safer but more liquid to drink. I take the cup of water and put it in the freezer letting it get a tiny film of ice on the top. While the water is cooling I lick my pinky and stick in in the powder and lick it... that's what the water will taste like.
I take the powder and pour all of it into the water, get a spoon and stir stir stir. I make sure all of the hydrocodone can dissolve into the water, in fact sometimes I will stir it and put it back in the freezer for a few mins and stir again, but the effectiveness is debatable I'm sure. After stirring I do 1 of 2 things or I do both:
I can let all the acetaminophen settle to the bottom and drink the liquid off the top with a straw but I will still have liquid in the sludge which and the water has hydrocodone in it. Or I get a coffee filter and a rubber band and put the filter in the cup and fold the edges around the lip of the cup and put the rubber band on around the cup to keep the filter there and pour the water into it, this takes a little while because the acetaminophen settles and slows the process, so once it starts slowing to a tiny drip I CAREFULLY take the rubber band off and CAREFULLY pick up the filter and twist to wring out the liquid...
Now the extraction is done, I have a liquid with hydocodone in it and a nasty glob of mostly pure Tylenol. I find sour things make a rely good chaser like lemon juice or stuff like powerade.
